description: Emisiones atmosféricas - Planta Minas is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by ANCAP. Datos del monitoreo de emisiones a la atmósfera por los hornos de producción en planta Minas. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher ANCAP. Its tags are ANCAP, Atmosféricas, Cambio climático, Emisiones, Planta Minas. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2024-04-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
